$sources: EN 1090-2 execution of steel structures refers to EN ISO 2553 for weld symbols; the drilling allowances and the cope clearance are SAEngine practice; see VERIFY.md
source: EN ISO 2553 weld symbols (system A, the European practice); SAEngine practice for the allowances

sources.weldSymbols: EN ISO 2553:2019 system A (dashed identification line), as EN 1090-2 drawings use it
sources.anchorHoleClearance: SAEngine practice: rod + 6 mm in the base plate
sources.copeClearance: SAEngine practice: 10 mm clear of the supporting beam's flange and root
